mapper.update: UPDATE hotel_bookings SET commission_percent = #{commissionPercent}, commission_amount = ROUND(total_amount * #{commissionPercent} / 100, 2), commission_rule_version = #{ruleVersion} WHERE id = #{id} AND commission_percent IS NULL

mapper.select:
SELECT b.id AS booking_id, 'HOTEL' AS booking_type, b.booking_code, b.check_out_date AS service_date, b.currency, b.total_amount, b.booking_status, b.guest_charged, b.cancellation_reason, b.commission_percent, b.commission_rule_version, COALESCE(b.guest_lead ->> 'fullName', b.guest_lead ->> 'name', u.full_name) AS guest_name FROM hotel_bookings b LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND b.check_out_date >= #{periodStart} AND b.check_out_date <= #{periodEnd} AND b.booking_status IN ('COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','CANCELLED_BY_GUEST','CANCELLED_BY_HOST','CANCELLED_BY_PLATFORM')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM partner_statement_lines l WHERE l.hotel_booking_id = b.id AND l.statement_id <> #{excludeStatementId})
ORDER BY b.check_out_date, b.booking_code

SELECT o.id AS booking_id, 'ACTIVITY' AS booking_type, o.order_code AS booking_code, s.starts_at::date AS service_date, o.currency, o.total_amount, o.order_status AS booking_status, o.guest_charged, o.commission_percent, o.commission_rule_version, COALESCE(o.contact_info ->> 'fullName', o.contact_info ->> 'name', u.full_name) AS guest_name, (SELECT e.reason FROM marketplace_audit_events e WHERE e.entity_type = 'ACTIVITY_ORDER' AND e.entity_id = o.id AND e.reason IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cancellation_reason FROM activity_orders o JOIN activity_slots s ON s.id = o.slot_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND s.starts_at::date >= #{periodStart} AND s.starts_at::date <= #{periodEnd} AND o.order_status IN ('COMPLETED','NO_SHOW','CANCELLED_BY_GUEST','CANCELLED_BY_HOST','CANCELLED_BY_PLATFORM')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM partner_statement_lines l WHERE l.activity_order_id = o.id AND l.statement_id <> #{excludeStatementId})
ORDER BY s.starts_at, o.order_code
mapper.update: UPDATE partner_statements SET status = 'SETTLED', settled_at = #{settledAt}, note = #{note}, data_version = data_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'SETTLED' AND issued_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM partner_statement_lines l WHERE l.statement_id = #{id} AND l.dispute_status = 'OPEN')
mapper.sql: SELECT s.*, o.display_name AS organization_name FROM partner_statements s JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id = s.organization_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM partner_statements WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
WHERE s.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND s.period_start = #{periodStart} AND s.period_end = #{periodEnd}
WHERE s.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND s.status <> 'OPEN' ORDER BY s.period_start DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partner_statements WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM partner_statement_lines WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} AND dispute_status = 'NONE'
mapper.update: UPDATE partner_statement_lines SET dispute_status = #{status}, dispute_resolution_note = #{note}, dispute_resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, dispute_resolved_at = #{resolvedAt} , commission_amount = 0, net_amount = gross_amount WHERE id = #{id} AND dispute_status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partner_statement_lines l JOIN partner_statements s ON s.id = l.statement_id WHERE s.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND l.dispute_status = 'OPEN'
